component.name: LINE
component.summary: Unofficial desktop wrapper for the LINE Chrome extension

description.p: Runs the official LINE Chrome extension in its own window, using a sandboxed Chromium that is bundled with the app.
This is an unofficial wrapper that LY Corporation neither makes nor endorses. The extension is downloaded from the Chrome Web Store when the app is built.
Initial package of LINE extension 3.7.2 with Chromium r1727463.
